name: [🎉NEW] Scary Hide & Seek
desc:
Welcome to Scary Hide & Seek! 💀🔍

🔦 HIDER: As a hider, your goal is to blend in with the environment by disguising yourself as everyday objects. Stay hidden, outsmart the seekers, and survive the hunt until the time runs out.
🔪 SEEKER: As a seeker, your task is to hunt down players disguised as objects. Use your horrifying skills to track them down and reveal their hiding spots before they slip away.

🔓 Collect coins to unlock powerful abilities, exclusive skins, and deadly weapons

👍 Don't forget to LIKE and FAVORITE the game to stay updated on all the latest features and improvements! ⭐

🏷️ Tags: Hide and Seek, Disguise, Prop, Find, Ultimate, Tag,  Adventure, Puzzle, Teamwork, Seeker, Hiding, Taunt Hunt, Sneak, Extreme, Round
